paragraphs: [Bava Batra 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.29a.5): Abaye said to Rav Nachman, “If so, those of the household of Bar Elyashiv, who object even to one who passes over their boundary,” etc. In [Ketubot 54a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.54a.21), a daughter-in-law of the household of Bar Elyashiv was claiming her ketubah from orphans; they came before Ravina, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Bava Batra uses the household as an example in a discussion of land possession. Ketubot names a daughter-in-law of the household in a separate case before Ravina.
